title: thread-stamp/1
description: A stamp: an event record at thread/stamps/<work id>/<YYYYMMDD-HHMM>.json saying that a work item's output was produced or checked against these values. The stamp id (the filename stem, repeated in `stamp`) encodes the time and nothing else in it is time-dependent. Written only by `fy thread stamp`, never edited. The newest stamp by name is the baseline. `value` is the address's value when its canonical JSON is at most 2 KB, otherwise null beside the hash.

pinned.description: A pinned baseline turns a difference into `drifted` (a disposition for Joe) instead of `stale`.
